title: Alweda aye hussain
body:
ALIVIDA AYE HUSSAIN AYE HUSSAIN ALVIDA
AYE RASOOL-E-MUKARRAM KEY CHAIN ALIVIDA
ZINATE DO JAHAN AYE TERE NAQSHE PAA
TERE SAJDE KIYE MAGHRABAIN ALVIDA
<<DIVIDER>>
MAJLISE TERI HAR GHAR MEIN HO JALWA GAR
TUJKO ROTI HEIN DUNIYA HUSSAIN ALVIDA
CHANDINI RAAT PAR MURDANI CHAGAYI
KHO GAYA CHAND TAARAO KA CHAIN ALVIDA
<<DIVIDER>>
SAR KHULE FATIMA AARAHI HAI NAZAR
RO RAHE HEIN SHAHE MASHRAQAIN ALVIDA
HUM JIYENGEY TO AGLEY BARAS ROYENGEY PHIR SE HOGA YEHI SHOUR-O-SHAIN ALVIDA
